title: Mama Bear and Her Three Cubs
content: I'm sitting at the breakfast table, looking up a lot from my computer, because Mama Bear has been visiting our backyard with her cubs. They're cute, but destructive, raiding and destroying our bird feeders.It reminds me of the painting "Morning in a Pine Forest" by Ivan Shishkin and Konstantin Savitsky.According to Wikipedia, the bears in the painting were painted by Savitsky. However, the art collector Pavel Tretyakov effaced Savitsky's signature, stating that "from idea until performance, everything discloses the painting manner and creative method peculiar just to Shishkin", so the painting is now sometimes credited solely to Shishkin.
